# Waylock guides

Waylock is an Android route-planning app. Waylock is in internal testing. Public installation is not available yet. Device checks on the route controls remain open, so these guides describe planned controls rather than steps you can rely on.

## Start here
- [Guide overview](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/)
- [Release status](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/release-status)
- [Route controls](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/route-controls)
- [Account and data](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/account-and-data)
- [Moving from another app](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/compare)

## Related site
- [Waylock](https://waylock.aoneahsan.com/)
- [Compare Waylock with other route and road trip apps](https://waylock.aoneahsan.com/compare)

- [Terms of Service](https://waylock.aoneahsan.com/terms)

No public Waylock API is documented here.
